first_failures.detail: Resizing replaced the selected 400x241 crop with the original 1000x600 image.
AppKit disables its native zoom widget when native resizing is removed. A same-location Legacy zoom/restore control now preserves the action.
On CI macOS 15 and 26, a throttled initial timer could run after the website opened history. Already-collapsed state is now recorded in the first recognized layout.
All three CI hosts passed 13/14 UI scenarios, but keypad Enter did not produce the second image. AppKit character normalization and bounded offline key/phase diagnostics added; fresh CI required.
A fresh nonrepeat press was rejected after an earlier key-up went to another window. The gate now distinguishes a new press from autorepeat.

The new NSView grip inherited false for acceptsFirstMouse. It now accepts the initial drag; the packaged scenario also sends the gesture through an independent foreground host and checks that host remains active.

Character-first normalization assigned Fn-Return a different identity from the same physical Return key after Fn release. Known physical Return/Enter key codes now take precedence; character fallback is retained for virtual events.
A zero-area focus click discarded an existing crop. It now preserves selected image pixels; only Reset clears the crop and a valid drag replaces it.
Initial collapse could still synthesize a click on website Home for a floating drawer. This action is removed; Home may navigate, so floating website history is left alone.

macOS 27 packaged UI first background-host grip drag resized from 640 to 720 points but moved x from 100 to 178 instead of keeping the top-left fixed. Both nonopaque interactive views inherited mouseDownCanMoveWindow=true. Grip and crop canvas now explicitly return false; native regression failed on both before repair.

Native hydration/restored-open test timed out on macOS 15; packaged UI round 1 passed 14/14. DOM-only fixtures now ignore unrelated physical mouse events and report ready/hydration/expanded state on failure; the original collapse assertion and timing limits remain.

packaged_xctest.reason: CLT only; preserved the user QA042 instance and global shortcuts.

manual_packaged_ui.reason: Computer-use session was interrupted before app inspection; isolated preview was closed normally. User QA042 and login data were preserved.

background_drag_regression.assertions: Grip and crop canvas opt out of AppKit window dragging; first mouse is accepted.

ci.reason: Keypad Enter case failed on all three hosts; native initial-collapse race also failed on 15 and 26. No retries of unchanged code.

receiver.requires: Three independent Teams desktop whole-display / Chrome receiver trials including system cursor.

native_cursor_experiment.reason: Isolated public API probe lacked continuous live-resize/system-cursor samples in the remote development interaction. Uniform protected in-window grip selected.

intermediate_ci.reason: Additional reproduced missing-key-up defect repaired before release; final commit needs a fresh complete matrix.
Initial-drag acceptance and a background-host UI assertion added before release; final source requires a complete fresh matrix.
Physical Return identity stabilized before final release verification.
Crop focus-click retention and removal of the remaining automatic Home action were added before delivery.
Reproduced background-drag defect requires interactive views to opt out of window dragging. macOS 15 native failure retained for diagnosis before the next commit.

native_failure.detail: Initial-collapse timeout; input isolation and failure diagnostics added without reducing assertions.
